description:
Here are the descriptions of the provided plots, following your guidelines:

The plot illustrates the relationship between iteration number and loss for several different model configurations. The x-axis is labeled “#Iteration” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 140000, with tick labels at intervals of 20000. The y-axis is labeled “Loss” and has a linear scale ranging from 2.4 to 3.4, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. 

The first line, colored purple and without markers, represents “Vanilla” and begins at approximately 3.3 and declines to approximately 2.55 by 140000 iterations. The second line, colored red and without markers, represents “StrmLLM (n=64)” and starts at approximately 3.3, declining to approximately 2.5 by 140000 iterations. The third line, colored orange and without markers, represents “SepLLM (n=64)” and begins at approximately 3.3, declining to approximately 2.6 by 140000 iterations. The fourth line, colored green and without markers, represents “SepLLM (n=64, H)” and starts at approximately 3.3, declining to approximately 2.6 by 140000 iterations. The fifth line, colored pink and without markers, represents “SepLLM (n=64, H/T)” and begins at approximately 3.3, declining to approximately 2.5 by 140000 iterations. The sixth line, colored blue and without markers, represents “SepLLM (n=128)” and starts at approximately 3.3, declining to approximately 2.6 by 140000 iterations.
